title.narrative: Enabling activities to review and update the national implementation plan for the stockholm convention on POPs

description.narrative: To review and update the NIP for the SC on POPs and to have it endorsed and submitted to COP The overall objective of the proposed Enabling Activities (EA) is to review and update the National Implementation Plan (NIP), and have it endorsed and submitted by the Government to the Conference of the Parties of the Stockholm Convention (COP). Participating stakeholders will be able to manage the additional POPs with newly developed technical skills, expertise and awareness
